title: R3 reporting owner digest notifications providers marketplace and edge integrations
businessRules: Owner digest mutations require explicit permission and disabled configuration cannot send manually.
Owner digest recipients must resolve to verified non-revoked Telegram bindings; raw destination strings are not configuration authority.
Low-stock digest compares actual branch inventory against each product minStock without a hard-coded prefilter.
Provider, payment diagnostic, marketplace, and edge operations remain tenant scoped, auditable, retryable, and fail closed.
R3 CRITICAL/HIGH findings require live GitHub runtime evidence before CLOSED.
Residual closure for F37/F39/F42/F43 adds operator surfaces and tenant-scoped diagnostics only; R7 remains blocked until exact-source PostgreSQL runtime evidence passes.
acceptanceCriteria: F22 owner digest has an operator configuration surface.
F23 owner digest mutations are permission protected.
F24 disabled digest cannot be manually sent.
F25 low-stock digest does not miss products whose minStock exceeds 10.
F29 ExternalMapping has runtime lifecycle and operator surface.
F37 payment provider diagnostics has operator UI.
F42 edge device/sync operations have complete operator workflow.
F43 marketplace order operations have Admin UI.
F44 owner digest uses verified recipient bindings rather than raw recipient strings.
GitHub provider/runtime probe exercises verified recipient plus digest delivery on PostgreSQL exact source.
F42 device diagnostics read path is tenant/branch scoped and exposes receipt/offline transaction status required for acknowledgement and requeue operations.
Both GitHub PostgreSQL workflows run ci:r3:residual-probe and aggregate evidence requires the residual R3 probe PASS.
testPlan: Inventory low-stock regression verifies branch stock/minStock reporting without inventory movement mutation.
Edge sync regression verifies idempotency, retry, duplicate packet, conflict, receipt acknowledgement, and dead-letter requeue.
GitHub ci:r3:residual-probe on exact PostgreSQL runtime
migrationPlan: No schema change in the first R3 cluster; reuse EmployeeChannelBinding, SystemSetting, Notification, IntegrationConnection, and existing edge/payment/marketplace models. Any later schema requirement must be expand-only and parity-safe.
rollbackPlan: Revert R3 source while preserving existing verified bindings, notification history, and integration records. Do not delete delivery/audit history.
monitoringPlan: Provider simulation, notification delivery status/attempts/lastError, sync receipts/dead-letter, payment provider events, and aggregate GitHub evidence remain authoritative.
securityNotes: Raw provider recipients are not trusted configuration. Secrets remain encrypted/redacted; tenant context comes from authenticated identity.
releaseEvidence: Owner daily digest configuration and verified-recipient chain present and exercised
Stage-20 automated PASS; Human Stage-20 remains PENDING
